decision.explanation: The question asks for the educational institution(s) Luca Nenna attended. Source D1 explicitly states he received his Ph.D. from 'Université Paris IX - Dauphine' (D1S5, D1S13) and that he can be considered an alumnus of 'PSL University' because the former is a constituent university (D1S17). Source D2, a narrative text, states he was a 'graduate student at the University of Bergen' (D2S4). Although D2 contains a contradictory claim that he earned his Ph.D. from Université Paris IX - Dauphine while in Bergen (D2S12-13), the explicit statement about being a graduate student at the University of Bergen remains a valid reference to an institution he attended. All three institutions are supported by direct textual assertions regarding his attendance or alumni status.
